main.description: A seller-curated set of listings and product groups — a shop front section, a seasonal edit, a gift guide. Membership is listed here rather than declared by each member: a collection is authored as a unit, and keeping it on this record means reordering a shop front never rewrites the listings, which are the high-traffic records. The cost is that adding one item rewrites this record, which is acceptable precisely because collections are small and change rarely — the opposite of the inventory case that justified extracting stock.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the shop that curates this collection

images.description: Artwork for the collection itself, not for its members

items.description: AT URIs of the member listings and productGroups, in the order the seller wants them shown. Members need not all belong to the curating seller: a curated set of other sellers' listings is a legitimate use, which is why a promotion targeting this collection still only binds the promoting seller's own members.
